description: Per-token realized and unrealized PnL (average-cost basis) from the wallet's visible swap history, priced at swap time. An estimate: transfers/airdrops aren't cost basis and history is a recent window (stated in the result). Ends with a swap CTA to take profit or cut a loser. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
